generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The `Cap(FeatureFlag featureFlag)` constructor now calls `featureFlag.isEnabled()` once at enum-initialization time and stores the result. In the previous code, `featureFlag.isEnabled()` was called on every invocation of `isEnabled()`. If any feature flag in use can be toggled at runtime (e.g., via a REST API or system property change after startup), the new code will not reflect that change. If all feature flags used here are immutable after node startup, this is fine, but it is a subtle behavioral change worth confirming.
